name: maui-devflow-debug
description: Run DevFlow inspect-and-fix loops for MAUI apps. USE FOR: launch, device selection, agent recovery, broker/port/adb, tree/screenshot, Blazor CDP, and iterative UI debugging. DO NOT USE FOR: first-time setup or non-MAUI automation. INVOKES: DevFlow `maui_*` MCP tools when available; `maui devflow` CLI as fallback; `dotnet`, `adb`, and `simctl` for build, deployment, and connectivity work.
